title: Gold Bar Reload Vanilla Cream Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: The Gold Bar Reload Refill Prefilled Pods in Vanilla Cream Tobacco flavour offer a luxurious take on a traditional tobacco vape. Combining the deep, earthy notes of rich tobacco with the smooth sweetness of vanilla cream, these prefilled pods deliver a perfectly balanced and indulgent vaping experience. The Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit is designed for vapers seeking a convenient, compact device for premium vaping on the go. It mirrors the elegance and sophistication of the Gold Bar range, offering a reusable solution without the need to dispose of the whole device, thanks to its compatibility with Reload prefilled pods available in a selection of Gold Bar's most popular flavours. With these Gold Bar Reload prefilled pods, enjoy a variety of delightful flavours and a supremely satisfying MTL experience. Each pod's Hyper Mesh Coil technology ensures a smooth, flavourful vape with every draw. The prefilled design eliminates the fuss of refills and maintenance, simplifying vaping to just enjoying the experience. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg salt nicotine e-liquid, providing a smoother throat hit and faster absorption for quick satisfaction of nicotine cravings. With the Reload prefilled pods, the rechargeable Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit offers a more sustainable and flavourful alternative to disposable vapes, making it easy to switch flavours without waste.
